title: Bonjour l'art!
oneGoal: Students will recognize art exists everywhere around them
decisionPoints: How comfortable are students with French?
What visual supports are needed?
How much movement/gestures help?
progression: Foundation lesson - establishes art vocabulary and comfort zone
realWorldConnection: Looking for art in their bedroom, kitchen, playground

title: Mes yeux découvrent
oneGoal: Students will use their eyes to observe details in their environment
decisionPoints: Are students observing or just looking?
What draws their attention most?
How to extend their focus time?
progression: Builds on Lesson 1 by moving from awareness to active observation
realWorldConnection: Noticing shapes in clouds, patterns on clothing, textures on playground

title: J'aime, j'aime pas
oneGoal: Students will express simple preferences about visual things they see
decisionPoints: Are students comfortable expressing opinions?
How to support shy students?
What visual prompts help vocabulary?
progression: Builds on Lesson 2 by adding personal response to observation
realWorldConnection: Choosing favorite toys, clothes, or foods based on how they look

title: Mes mains créent
oneGoal: Students will explore basic art materials safely and confidently
decisionPoints: Are students handling materials appropriately?
What fine motor support is needed?
How to encourage exploration vs. perfection?
progression: Builds on Lesson 3 by transitioning from observer to creator
realWorldConnection: Drawing pictures for family, decorating their room, making cards

title: Lignes partout!
oneGoal: Students will create different types of lines with purpose
decisionPoints: Can students control their line-making?
What lines are they naturally drawn to?
How to connect lines to emotions/ideas?
progression: Builds on Lesson 4 by focusing creation on specific art elements
realWorldConnection: Lines in sidewalk cracks, tree branches, their own hair

title: Formes magiques
oneGoal: Students will recognize and create basic shapes in art
decisionPoints: Do students see shapes in complex images?
What shapes feel comfortable to draw?
How to build from simple to complex?
progression: Builds on Lesson 5 by organizing lines into recognizable forms
realWorldConnection: Shapes in their house windows, food, toys, and books

title: Couleurs vivantes
oneGoal: Students will use color intentionally to express ideas
decisionPoints: How do colors affect their mood?
What color choices are they making?
How to support color mixing exploration?
progression: Builds on Lesson 6 by adding color to shape and line knowledge
realWorldConnection: Colors in nature, their favorite foods, seasonal changes

title: Textures à toucher
oneGoal: Students will explore how texture can be shown in art
decisionPoints: Are students connecting touch to visual texture?
What textures fascinate them most?
How to make texture vocabulary stick?
progression: Builds on Lesson 7 by adding tactile dimension to visual elements
realWorldConnection: Feeling bark on trees, smooth stones, fuzzy sweaters

title: Mes sentiments en art
oneGoal: Students will connect their emotions to their artistic choices
decisionPoints: Are students making emotion-art connections?
How comfortable are they sharing feelings?
What artistic choices reflect their emotions?
progression: Builds on Lesson 8 by connecting all art elements to personal expression
realWorldConnection: Happy birthday drawings, comfort objects, celebrating achievements

title: Outils d'artiste
oneGoal: Students will select appropriate tools for their artistic intentions
decisionPoints: Are students choosing tools purposefully?
What fine motor skills need support?
How to encourage tool experimentation?
progression: Builds on Lesson 9 by expanding technical options for expression
realWorldConnection: Choosing right tools for jobs at home, helping with crafts

title: Techniques nouvelles
oneGoal: Students will try new art techniques to achieve different effects
decisionPoints: Are students willing to experiment?
What techniques feel natural to them?
How to balance instruction with discovery?
progression: Builds on Lesson 10 by expanding how tools can be used creatively
realWorldConnection: Different ways to spread jam, clean windows, or play in sand

title: Mon style unique
oneGoal: Students will recognize their own artistic preferences and style
decisionPoints: Can students identify their preferences?
How to celebrate individual differences?
What makes each student's work special?
progression: Builds on Lesson 11 by helping students recognize their emerging artistic identity
realWorldConnection: Their unique way of decorating, dressing, or arranging their space

title: Partager mes idées
oneGoal: Students will communicate about their art using French vocabulary learned
decisionPoints: Are students confident sharing their work?
What vocabulary do they use naturally?
How to support nervous speakers?
progression: Builds on Lesson 12 by adding communication component to artistic expression
realWorldConnection: Showing family their creations, explaining their room decorations

title: Art dans ma vie
oneGoal: Students will demonstrate understanding of how art connects to their daily experience
decisionPoints: Do students see art beyond school time?
How has their art awareness grown?
What connections are they making independently?
progression: Builds on Lesson 13 by completing the full circle from observation to creation to life application
realWorldConnection: Making art part of their daily routine, noticing design everywhere

title: Atelier libre
oneGoal: Students will practice all learned techniques in self-directed creation
decisionPoints: What techniques are students choosing?
How independent can they be?
Where do they need gentle guidance?
progression: Extension: Provides practice time to consolidate all learning from lessons 1-14
realWorldConnection: Having art time at home, making gifts, decorating personal spaces

title: Collaboration artistique
oneGoal: Students will work together on artistic projects using learned vocabulary
decisionPoints: How are students sharing materials and ideas?
What collaborative skills need support?
How to ensure everyone contributes?
progression: Extension: Builds on Lesson 15 by adding social dimension to art practice
realWorldConnection: Making art with siblings, friends, or family members

title: Art en grand
oneGoal: Students will apply their skills to larger-scale creative projects
decisionPoints: How do students adapt techniques to larger formats?
What planning skills are emerging?
How to maintain engagement with longer projects?
progression: Extension: Builds on Lesson 16 by challenging scale and scope of creation
realWorldConnection: Decorating their bedroom, making posters, creating gifts for family

title: Galerie de classe
oneGoal: Students will curate and present their artwork in a gallery setting
decisionPoints: How do students choose work to display?
What presentation skills are developing?
How comfortable are they as art critics?
progression: Extension: Builds on Lesson 17 by adding curatorial and presentation skills
realWorldConnection: Displaying their art at home, choosing what to show to visitors

title: Art et nature
oneGoal: Students will create art inspired by natural elements and materials
decisionPoints: How are students connecting to natural inspiration?
What natural materials appeal to them?
How to balance collection with conservation?
progression: Extension: Builds on Lesson 18 by expanding inspiration sources and materials
realWorldConnection: Collecting leaves and flowers, rock painting, nature photography

title: Célébration artistique
oneGoal: Students will celebrate their artistic growth and share with families
decisionPoints: What growth can students identify in themselves?
How confident are they sharing with families?
What artistic goals do they have going forward?
progression: Extension: Culminates all learning by celebrating growth and looking forward
realWorldConnection: Continuing to make art at home, noticing art everywhere, sharing creativity
